ops.text: On a Sprite lane, the drive relay (~/.local/bin/drive) gives up after 9 minutes on every verb while the coordinator's watch is busy (drive pr add, drive job set --repro and drive job report for j6166 each timed out), and the real answer arrives later only as an orchestration message, so the lane can't tell a lost verb from a slow one without running orca orchestration check by hand. The relay could wait on the reply message with orca orchestration check --wait after the 9-minute mark instead of exiting with 'its watch may still run it'.
